_about: Design tokens for d05-patch-switcher. Single source of the colour and type values in docs/design/DESIGN.md sections 2 and 3 (same names) and of the web-only values in docs/design/DESIGN-WEB.md. docs/design/gen-tokens.py writes the token comment block of assets/theme/app.qss and web/src/ui/theme.css from this file; run it with --check to verify app.qss, theme.css, src/ui/Theme.h and the mockup scripts agree. Edit this file, then DESIGN.md or DESIGN-WEB.md, then run the generator.

panel.qss: window background, upper panel, status bar, dialogs
panel.use: Window background, upper panel, status bar, dialogs

band.use: Lower band holding the grid, controls and list

bandEdge.qss: 1 px line on top of the band and the status bar
bandEdge.use: 1 px line on the top edge of the band, status bar top edge

well.use: List background (a recess in the band)

wellEdgeDark.qss: top and left 1 px border of the list well and fields
wellEdgeDark.use: Top and left 1 px border of the list well and fields

wellEdgeLight.qss: bottom and right 1 px border of the list well
wellEdgeLight.use: Bottom and right 1 px border of the list well and fields

fieldBack.qss: search field, combos, spin box, inline editor, tooltip
fieldBack.use: Search field, combo boxes, spin box, inline editor, tooltip

fieldBorder.qss: field border, normal; menu border and separator; disabled checkbox
fieldBorder.use: Field border, normal; disabled checkbox border

fieldBorderHover.qss: field border, hover; unchecked checkbox border
fieldBorderHover.use: Field border, hover; unchecked checkbox border

selection.qss: highlighted list row, menu item hover
selection.use: Highlighted list row, menu item hover

selectionBarIdle.qss: 3 px selection bar when the list is not focused
selectionBarIdle.use: 3 px selection bar when the list is not focused

matchBack.qss: search-match background; text selection in fields
matchBack.use: Search-match background in list rows; text selection in fields

bezel.use: Display window (the black recess around the lit field)

bezelRim.qss: 1 px frame left, right, bottom of the window
bezelRim.use: 1 px frame around the window, left, right and bottom

bezelRimTop.qss: 1 px frame on the top edge of the window
bezelRimTop.use: 1 px frame on the top edge of the window

lcdBack.use: Lit field background (near black, faint green cast)

labelPrimary.qss: legends, list names, values, dialog text
labelPrimary.use: Button legends, list names, values, dialog text

labelSecondary.qss: secondary labels, addresses, status labels, tags
labelSecondary.use: Secondary labels, addresses in the list, status labels, tags

labelDim.qss: placeholder text, unnamed user slots, hints
labelDim.use: Placeholder text, unnamed user slots, hints

labelAccent.qss: patch-section titles and numerals, the wordmark
labelAccent.use: Section titles and numerals of the patch section, the wordmark

ruleSecondary.qss: rules of secondary sections, wordmark divider
ruleSecondary.use: Rules of secondary sections (dialogs, list section), wordmark divider

labelRed.qss: AUTO SEND, NOT FOUND, errors, default-button border
labelRed.use: `AUTO SEND` label, `NOT FOUND`, error text, default-button border
labelRed.source: S2 red lettering hue 355 to 357, lifted for screen legibility (4.1 : 1 on `band`)

arrow.use: Solid wedges on PREV / NEXT and the combo arrow

tagBorder.use: 1 px box around the key-mode letter in list rows

buttonSlot.qss: 1 px recess around every button face
buttonSlot.use: 1 px recess around every button face

buttonHighlight.qss: 1 px top inside edge of the face (not pressed)
buttonHighlight.use: 1 px line on the top inside edge of the face (not when pressed)

buttonFaceLit.qss: face of a button whose LED is lit
buttonFaceLit.use: Face of a button whose LED is lit (flat red spill instead of a bloom)

ledCore.qss: lighter core inside a lit LED
ledCore.use: Lighter core inside a lit LED (the only "glow")

webColors._about: Web only (DESIGN-WEB.md section 2). Not in app.qss or Theme.h. Each is a token above with an alpha.

panelLabel.usedFor: Section titles, numerals 1 to 8, labels above buttons, button legends `U1`..`P6`

listName.usedFor: Patch names in the list, inline editor

listMeta.usedFor: Key-mode letter, recents count, edit counter

body.usedFor: Dialog text, checkbox text, menu items, combo text

note.usedFor: Settings reminder, About notices, empty-list second line

keycap.usedFor: Key caps in the Shortcuts sheet

webType._about: Web only (DESIGN-WEB.md section 3). Not in app.qss.

padLabel.usedFor: Legends inside phone pads: group legends, numerals in pads, view and SYSTEM legends, PREV / NEXT

dialogTitle.usedFor: Title in the title strip of in-page dialogs (replaces the native title bar)

breakpoints._about: CSS px of the layout viewport. DESIGN-WEB.md section 4.

size._about: Logical / CSS px. desktop = DESIGN.md (copied for the web), phone = DESIGN-WEB.md.
